id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_220.pack|cs_: "I had no choice... A third-rate fighter like me couldn't earn enough to feed the kids...
"This place is right beneath the orphanage. One day I was at my wits' end, with no money left, when I heard Arachtor's voice.
"Don't you want power...? If you do, come to me...
"To earn prize money at the tourney, I decided to take that power. I chose to become his tool...
"I knew it was a terrible deal. But to protect the place I grew up, the orphanage and the kids, it was the only way...
"You didn't direct that resolve into honest effort and fell for a monster's sweet words. That was your weakness...
"I have connections with the mayor of this town. I won't let things go badly for the orphanage. I'll see he takes some action.
"So rest easy and start your life anew.
And so the Octagonia missing persons case was solved, and {var:1} and the others spent the night at the inn.
